Files taken unchanged from the package: `dist/ajv2020.min.js`, `ajv@8.17.1:LICENSE`. Their SHA-256 hashes are in
[`SHA256SUMS`](SHA256SUMS), checked by the R13 test. The browser bundle of Ajv's JSON Schema 2020-12 validator, published by the Ajv project as ajv-dist. That package has no licence file, so `LICENSE` is taken from the same version of the ajv package. Used by the draft and validate pages to check records in the browser.

Refresh with `python tools/vendor.py ajv 8.17.1`.
